# Cozy Nook Craft Co.

> Small handmade bookish gift shop in North Las Vegas, Nevada, run by Sheri Berg. Every piece is made, wrapped and packed by hand. We ship anywhere in the United States.

## What we make and offer
- Custom folded book art (page-folding book sculptures) and book-page keepsakes
- Blind Date with a Book ("Pick a Genre, Not a Cover")
- Cozy Clearcase: decorated clear book cases, sold on their own or bundled with a book
- Holiday gift bundles, including Cozy Cocoa & Chapters
- Cozy Books Scented Stories: hand-poured bookish soy wax melts
- Cozy Bears and Gender Reveal Bears
- Resin trinket trays, phone holders and other handmade gifts
- Gift cards
- Custom orders
- Online classes via Zoom: book page folding and altered composition notebooks
- Monthly Cozy Nook book club

## Location and service area
Based in North Las Vegas, Nevada. Local pickup and local delivery by arrangement in North Las Vegas, Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, Spring Valley and Paradise. Ships anywhere in the United States. Handmade orders take 7–10 days to complete before shipping.

## Prices
Most pieces are $15 to $55 (Blind Date with a Book $35, Custom Folded Book Art $45, Cozy Clearcase Bundle with a Book $45). Gift cards $25 to $100.
